subject.title: Request: delete stale plugin entries claw-pay-plugin (v0.27, v0.25) from Publisher Plugins

question: Should maintainers remove the currently visible `claw-pay-plugin` package/releases, or treat only the already-missing originally requested rows as resolved?
rationale: The public API no longer exposes the exact requested versions, but a live executable payment-plugin package remains; changing its registry visibility is a production trust and audit decision that automation should not infer from the stale wording alone.

options.title: Reconfirm targets before deletion
options.body: Ask the publisher or an authorized maintainer to confirm the exact current package/release rows, then delete only confirmed stale targets through the audited lifecycle path.

options.title: Remove the current plugin package
options.body: If maintainers confirm `claw-pay-plugin` itself is obsolete, soft-delete the package or delete eligible non-latest versions with the existing package lifecycle tooling.

options.title: Close after owner confirms current state
options.body: If the publisher confirms the exact stale rows are gone and the current `0.2.7`/`0.2.6` package should remain, close without further deletion.

recommendation.title: Reconfirm targets before deletion
recommendation.body: Ask the publisher or an authorized maintainer to confirm the exact current package/release rows, then delete only confirmed stale targets through the audited lifecycle path.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is tied by current history to package lifecycle tooling and has recent package trust workflow context.
